slides.text: Never let anything talk to clients without this test
slides.voiceover_text: Never let any new tool talk to your clients without running this test first. Twenty minutes that save embarrassments.

slides.text: Write twenty real questions clients actually ask
slides.voiceover_text: One. Write down twenty real questions clients actually ask. Pricing. Service area. Availability. Edge cases. Your real questions, not the polished ones.

slides.text: Ask each one three different ways. Look for drift
slides.voiceover_text: Two. Ask each question three different ways. Same answer every time? Good. Different answers? That's the problem you'd otherwise discover on a real customer.

slides.text: Throw in the ambiguous and incomplete ones
slides.voiceover_text: Three. Throw in vague and incomplete questions. A good tool admits when it doesn't know. A dangerous one confidently invents an answer.

slides.text: Real questions. Three ways. Edge cases.
slides.voiceover_text: Real questions. Three different ways. Plus the edge cases. Twenty minutes that protect your reputation.
